source.method: Original four-test reaction-matrix suite, all original 1.31–1.35 frozen comparisons, v6/v7 parity and 24-case aura-v9 release digest assertions unchanged. A read-only import wrapper captures config/options before each of 130 simulate calls and the full result before its consumer. Deduplication to 79 cases requires byte-identical inputs AND results for every repeated case. No current result is stripped, renumbered or relabelled.

observedAt.test: 1.35 provisional reaction-matrix Golden > keeps all 17 frozen classic vectors at aura-v6 parity in aura-v7 except the explicit Burning projection fix
